name: Counterparty Risk
definition: Calculation of the exposure amount that one party has vis-a-vis one counterparty or a central system, based on its credit risk.

ExposedAmount.name: Exposed Amount
ExposedAmount.definition: The amount which needs to be covered for the counterparty risk.

SecureMarketValue.name: Secure Market Value
SecureMarketValue.definition: The market value of the financial instruments being used to secure the facility.

LiquidResourceValue.name: Liquid Resource Value
LiquidResourceValue.definition: Amount of liquid resources available to meet liquid requirements.

Party.name: Party
Party.definition: Specifies which role played by a party was taken into consideration for the risk calculation, for instance clearing member role.

ExposureCalculation.name: Exposure Calculation
ExposureCalculation.definition: Specifies the exposure for which the risk is calculated on a counterparty basis.
